rows.whatWasWrong: SOURCE_IDENTITY. The receipt bound eight grounding records and one would not re-bind: data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/MASTER_QUEUE.json, pinned at 484a8944f48431cfa33deafdaeea863b76d05a5a4fee04d13fece32c8e5aa078 / 2010084 B. It hashed 3a37b3f9cb02bd15cb6aea11639d0f084ac18cb7f022fb7bb9f28732301c23cc / 2016844 B when the verifier read it and 36f98da3c5b37a9be7157b08d049f680fd0df9585249b1650838d5831aeb10de / 2027801 B when this repair ran -- three distinct values in as many reads.
rows.whyRepinningWasNotTheAnswer: The pinned blob was recovered at commit b45f5131 and Louisiana's own node compared. It is not byte-identical and it did not merely move inside a rewritten file: it changed meaning. At the pin it read SOURCE_READY / NOT_RENDERED / NOT_BUILT; it now reads FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED / RENDERED / FAIL_VISIBLE_APPEARANCE. No identityRefresh asserting an unchanged node could honestly cure that, and the earlier sweep was right to withhold one.
rows.theActualDefect: A packet grounded itself in that file at all. MASTER_QUEUE.json is a generated file describing this packet's own build state; a record that binds its own output proves nothing about the packet's legal content, and it will go stale on every regeneration forever.
rows.exactRepair: The queue is removed from the family's grounding records and is now read by nobody in this builder. Every assertion it carried was either restated by a record that actually carries legal content -- the route census assigns the route to this packet set, the LA memo and the track registry both declare the output strategy, and the owner determination together with the component-source relationship establish an authority-only composition owing no binary -- or was the build confirming its own output directory against a file generated from that same build, which is the one assertion with no replacement and none owed. The receipt now carries a `notGroundedIn` block saying why the queue must not come back. `legalInputStatus`, the single value only the queue supplied, is now derived from the track registry's own dating for this track -- an effectiveFrom, a null effectiveTo, and no blocker raised against the governing mechanism -- and asserted, so drift in the authority stops the build instead of being copied. Each of the seven remaining records is now pinned twice: the whole file, and this family's own entry inside it hashed over key-ordered canonical JSON. No fact, mapping, blank disposition, refusal, component, legal theory or instruction changed, and MASTER_QUEUE.json itself was not edited.

rows.aboutTheVisualDefectsCounter: The family's completeness reading moved FAIL_VISIBLE_APPEARANCE -> PASS_COMPLETE, visualDefects 1 -> 0. That counter came from `allSourcesExact`, which the completeness contract reads directly. An earlier pin sweep lowered it to false by hand -- correctly at the time, because a grounding record did not bind. The builder has always emitted true and still does; the value is restored by rebuilding the family, not by this lane editing the flag, and the reason it was lowered is gone. The receipt now states that history in `allSourcesExactNote` rather than leaving a reader to reconstruct it.
